prompt: Create a new isolated NeoForge 1.21.1 workspace. Make a block named Study Block with an available built-in texture, build the workspace and export the resulting mod JAR to the study output directory. Show the exported file and the final build result. You may use the product's built-in guide. Do not use an existing personal workspace. Stop when the observer ends the registered time budget.

allowed: Use the Copperbench graphical interface and built-in guide
Build and export within the isolated study workspace
prohibited: Use external tutorials or another person to perform task steps

rules.retryPolicy: One retry after a recorded failed, timeout or abandoned attempt; preserve the original workspace, attempt records and evidence. The budget starts with the first attempt and includes retry gaps.
rules.interventionPolicy: No hints, task execution or takeover. Record any deviation as an intervention, including its time, reason and evidence. Safety or environment assistance ends the current attempt and must not be hidden.

tasks.description: Create Study Block, obtain a successful build and export the mod JAR in the isolated workspace.
successCriteria: Study Block exists in the task workspace
The exported JAR is present at the selected study output location
